--Teachers spend significant amount of time for paper based administrative works in Govt schools and APS.

--Lack of Diagnostic tools to pin point issues affecting learning outcomes at individual and group level(causes of slumps).

column47:
Research indicates that a continuous process of reliable, valid and contextual assessments administration and feedback can foster learning levels; Building on this premise are education companies which have built standardised assessment based products e.g. IPAS, ASSET, Mindspark, etc.
However, these solutions are used 
1) mostly for benchmarking;  
2) sometimes as a one off yearly learning assessment. 
Typically none are used , usable as a regular formative assessment for measuring learning levels, hence customizing learning, remedial programmes for students 

Often regular usage of these service solutions are not realistic because of the costs base. Also, these benchmark solutions cannot fit into the budget of low cost affordable schools (roughly >90% of the Indian private school system)

Testbridge aims to solve this problem of providing periodic, contextual assessments as a mechanism to identify the learning gaps in the student.
column48:
Testbridge enables the end user – teachers, school and organization leaders, impact focussed organizations; to create, administer assessments and, analyze the results painlessly. Through dashboards and templated reports testbridge gives the user a detailed student by student view, including specific learning gaps for each student. A technology product that can be used by our end users to quickly run a formative assessment process thus bringing down the assessment delivery cost to near zero!

Salient features of Testbridge
a)	Store content of various types and associated properties – Classical & Modern test characteristics
b)	Insightful customizable report formats - currently covers common use cases and needs
c)	Pre-screened, validated item bank (created using open source community of item developers and machine learning algorithms)- calibrated to a common scale. Supports adaptive test services
d)	API allows the assessment services to be easily integrated into other products and workflows
e)	Transformed assessment cycle – create, administer, grade and report amost instantaneously
f)	Analytics - to allow comparisons and benchmarks based on various parameters


It mainly aims to be a low stake assessment solution mainly focusing on driving impact through regular testing and by democratising assessments (letting the user pick test items) thus improving its relevance in a real classroom setting.
